cast_hint: Dudley Moore, Julie Andrews, Bo Derek
plot_hint: A Hollywood songwriter goes through a mid-life crisis and becomes infatuated with a sexy blonde newlywed.
tagline_text: A temptingly tasteful comedy for adults who can count.

title: 10 Things I Hate About You
cast_hint: Heath Ledger, Julia Stiles, Joseph Gordon-Levitt
plot_hint: On the first day at his new school, Cameron instantly falls for Bianca, the gorgeous girl of his dreams. The only problem is that Bianca is forbidden to date until her ill-tempered, completely un-dateable older sister Kat goes out, too. In an attempt to solve his problem, Cameron singles out the only guy who could possibly be a match for Kat: a mysterious bad boy with a nasty reputation of his own.
tagline_text: How do I loathe thee? Let me count the ways.

title: 101 Dalmatians
cast_hint: Glenn Close, Jeff Daniels, Joely Richardson
plot_hint: An evil, high-fashion designer plots to steal Dalmatian puppies in order to make an extravagant fur coat, but instead creates an extravagant mess.
tagline_text: So many dogs. So little time.

title: 12 Years a Slave
cast_hint: Chiwetel Ejiofor, Michael Fassbender, Lupita Nyong'o
plot_hint: In the pre-Civil War United States, Solomon Northup, a free black man from upstate New York, is abducted and sold into slavery. Facing cruelty as well as unexpected kindnesses Solomon struggles not only to stay alive, but to retain his dignity. In the twelfth year of his unforgettable odyssey, Solomon’s chance meeting with a Canadian abolitionist will forever alter his life.
tagline_text: The extraordinary true story of Solomon Northup.

title: 127 Hours
cast_hint: James Franco, Kate Mara, Amber Tamblyn
plot_hint: The true story of mountain climber Aron Ralston's remarkable adventure to save himself after a fallen boulder crashes on his arm and traps him in an isolated canyon in Utah.
tagline_text: Every second counts.

cast_hint: George MacKay, Dean-Charles Chapman, Mark Strong
plot_hint: At the height of the First World War, two young British soldiers must cross enemy territory and deliver a message that will stop a deadly attack on hundreds of soldiers.
tagline_text: Time is the enemy.

title: 2 Fast 2 Furious
cast_hint: Paul Walker, Tyrese Gibson, Eva Mendes
plot_hint: It's a major double-cross when former police officer Brian O'Conner teams up with his ex-con buddy Roman Pearce to transport a shipment of "dirty" money for shady Miami-based import-export dealer Carter Verone. But the guys are actually working with undercover agent Monica Fuentes to bring Verone down.
tagline_text: How fast do you like it?

title: 3 Men and a Baby
cast_hint: Tom Selleck, Steve Guttenberg, Ted Danson
plot_hint: Three bachelors find themselves forced to take care of a baby left by one of the guy's girlfriends.
tagline_text: They changed her diapers. She changed their lives.

cast_hint: Gerard Butler, Lena Headey, Dominic West
plot_hint: A story very loosely based the 480 B.C. Battle of Thermopylae, where the King of Sparta led his army against the advancing Persians.
tagline_text: Prepare for glory!

title: A Beautiful Mind
cast_hint: Russell Crowe, Jennifer Connelly, Ed Harris
plot_hint: From the heights of notoriety to the depths of depravity, John Forbes Nash Jr. experiences it all. As a brilliant but socially awkward mathematician, he made a groundbreaking discovery early in his career and stands on the brink of international acclaim. But as the handsome and arrogant Nash accepts secret work in cryptography, he becomes entangled in a mysterious conspiracy. His life takes a nightmarish turn and he soon finds himself on a painful and harrowing journey of self-discovery.
tagline_text: He saw the world in a way no one could have imagined.

title: A Bridge Too Far
cast_hint: Dirk Bogarde, James Caan, Michael Caine
plot_hint: The story of Operation Market Garden—a failed attempt by the allies in the latter stages of WWII to end the war quickly by securing three bridges in Holland allowing access over the Rhine into Germany. A combination of poor allied intelligence and the presence of two crack German panzer divisions meant that the final part of this operation (the bridge in Arnhem over the Rhine) was doomed to failure.
tagline_text: Out of the sky comes the screen's most incredible spectacle of men and war!

title: A Bug's Life
cast_hint: Dave Foley, Kevin Spacey, Julia Louis-Dreyfus
plot_hint: On behalf of "oppressed bugs everywhere," an inventive ant named Flik hires a troupe of warrior bugs to defend his bustling colony from a horde of freeloading grasshoppers led by the evil-minded Hopper.
tagline_text: An epic of miniature proportions.

title: A Complete Unknown
cast_hint: Timothée Chalamet, Edward Norton, Elle Fanning
plot_hint: New York, early 1960s. Against the backdrop of a vibrant music scene and tumultuous cultural upheaval, an enigmatic 19-year-old from Minnesota arrives in the West Village with his guitar and revolutionary talent, destined to change the course of American music.
tagline_text: The ballad of a true original.

title: A Few Good Men
cast_hint: Tom Cruise, Jack Nicholson, Demi Moore
plot_hint: When cocky military lawyer Lt. Daniel Kaffee and his co-counsel, Lt. Cmdr. JoAnne Galloway, are assigned to a murder case, they uncover a hazing ritual that could implicate high-ranking officials such as shady Col. Nathan Jessep.
tagline_text: In the heart of the nation's capital, in a courthouse of the U.S. government, one man will stop at nothing to keep his honor, and one will stop at nothing to find the truth.

title: A Fish Called Wanda
cast_hint: Jamie Lee Curtis, John Cleese, Kevin Kline
plot_hint: While a diamond advocate attempts to steal a collection of diamonds, troubles arise when he realises he’s not the only one after the collection.
tagline_text: A tale of murder, lust, greed, revenge, and seafood.

title: A League of Their Own
cast_hint: Tom Hanks, Geena Davis, Lori Petty
plot_hint: As America's stock of athletic young men is depleted during World War II, a professional all-female baseball league springs up in the Midwest, funded by publicity-hungry candy maker Walter Harvey. Competitive sisters Dottie Hinson and Kit Keller spar with each other, scout Ernie Capadino and grumpy has-been coach Jimmy Dugan on their way to fame.
tagline_text: Once in a lifetime you get a chance to do something different.

title: A Minecraft Movie
cast_hint: Jason Momoa, Jack Black, Sebastian Eugene Hansen
plot_hint: Four misfits find themselves struggling with ordinary problems when they are suddenly pulled through a mysterious portal into the Overworld: a bizarre, cubic wonderland that thrives on imagination. To get back home, they'll have to master this world while embarking on a magical quest with an unexpected, expert crafter, Steve.
tagline_text: Be there and be square.

title: A Passage to India
cast_hint: Judy Davis, Victor Banerjee, Peggy Ashcroft
plot_hint: Cultural mistrust and false accusations doom a friendship in British colonial India between an Indian doctor, an Englishwoman engaged to marry a city magistrate, and an English educator.
tagline_text: David Lean, the Director of "Doctor Zhivago", "Lawrence of Arabia" and "The Bridge on the River Kwai", invites you on . .

title: A Quiet Place Part II
cast_hint: Emily Blunt, John Krasinski, Millicent Simmonds
plot_hint: Following the events at home, the Abbott family now face the terrors of the outside world. Forced to venture into the unknown, they realize that the creatures that hunt by sound are not the only threats that lurk beyond the sand path.
tagline_text: Silence is not enough.

title: A Quiet Place: Day One
cast_hint: Lupita Nyong'o, Joseph Quinn, Alex Wolff
plot_hint: As New York City is invaded by alien creatures who hunt by sound, a woman named Sam fights to survive with her cat.
tagline_text: Hear how it all began.

title: A Room with a View
cast_hint: Helena Bonham Carter, Julian Sands, Maggie Smith
plot_hint: When Lucy Honeychurch and chaperon Charlotte Bartlett find themselves in Florence with rooms without views, fellow guests Mr Emerson and son George step in to remedy the situation. Meeting the Emersons could change Lucy's life forever but, once back in England, how will her experiences in Tuscany affect her marriage plans?
tagline_text: An Edwardian Romance

title: A Serious Man
cast_hint: Michael Stuhlbarg, Richard Kind, Fred Melamed
plot_hint: It is 1967, and Larry Gopnik, a physics professor at a quiet Midwestern university, has just been informed by his wife Judith that she is leaving him. She has fallen in love with one of his more pompous acquaintances Sy Ableman.
tagline_text: Accept mystery.

title: A Soldier's Story
cast_hint: Howard Rollins, Adolph Caesar, Art Evans
plot_hint: In a rural town in Louisiana, a black Master Sergeant is found shot to death just outside the local Army Base. Military lawyer, Captain Davenport—also a black man—is sent from Washington to conduct an investigation. Facing an uncooperative chain of command and fearful black troops, Davenport must battle with deceit and prejudice in order to find out exactly who really did kill the Master Sergeant.
tagline_text: Alone, far from home, and far from justice, he has three days to learn the truth about a murder... and the truth is a story you won't forget.

title: Ace Ventura: Pet Detective
cast_hint: Jim Carrey, Courteney Cox, Sean Young
plot_hint: He's Ace Ventura: Pet Detective. The Ace is on the case to find the Miami Dolphins' missing mascot and quarterback Dan Marino. He goes eyeball to eyeball with a man-eating shark, stakes out the Miami Dolphins and woos and wows the ladies. Whether he's undercover, under fire or underwater, he always gets his man… or beast!
tagline_text: He's the best there is! (Actually, he's the only one there is.)

title: Ace Ventura: When Nature Calls
cast_hint: Jim Carrey, Ian McNeice, Simon Callow
plot_hint: Summoned from an ashram in Tibet, Ace finds himself on a perilous journey into the jungles of Africa to find Shikaka, the missing sacred animal of the friendly Wachati tribe. He must accomplish this before the wedding of the Wachati's Princess to the prince of the warrior Wachootoos. If Ace fails, the result will be a vicious tribal war.
tagline_text: New animals. New adventures. Same hair.

title: Addams Family Values
cast_hint: Anjelica Huston, Raúl Juliá, Christopher Lloyd
plot_hint: Siblings Wednesday and Pugsley Addams will stop at nothing to get rid of Pubert, the new baby boy adored by parents Gomez and Morticia. Things go from bad to worse when the new "black widow" nanny, Debbie Jellinsky, launches her plan to add Fester to her collection of dead husbands.
tagline_text: The family just got a little stranger.

title: Air Force One
cast_hint: Harrison Ford, Gary Oldman, Glenn Close
plot_hint: When Russian neo-nationalists hijack Air Force One, the world's most secure and extraordinary aircraft, the President is faced with a nearly impossible decision to give in to terrorist demands or sacrifice not only the country's dignity, but the lives of his wife and daughter.
tagline_text: The fate of the nation rests on the courage of one man.

title: Airplane!
cast_hint: Robert Hays, Julie Hagerty, Leslie Nielsen
plot_hint: An ex-fighter pilot forced to take over the controls of an airliner when the flight crew succumbs to food poisoning.
tagline_text: What's slower than a speeding bullet, and able to hit tall buildings at a single bound?

title: Airport '77
cast_hint: Jack Lemmon, Lee Grant, Brenda Vaccaro
plot_hint: Flight 23 has crashed in the Bermuda Triangle after a hijacking gone wrong. Now the surviving passengers must brave panic, slow leaks, oxygen depletion, and more while attempting a daring plan, all while 200 feet underwater.
tagline_text: Flight 23 has crashed in the Bermuda Triangle... passengers still alive, trapped underwater...

title: Aladdin
cast_hint: Scott Weinger, Robin Williams, Linda Larkin
plot_hint: In the boorish city of Agrabah, kind-hearted street urchin Aladdin and Princess Jasmine fall in love, although she can only marry a prince. He and power-hungry Grand Vizier Jafar vie for a magic lamp that can fulfill their wishes.
tagline_text: Imagine if you had three wishes, three hopes, three dreams and they all could come true.

title: Alice in Wonderland
cast_hint: Mia Wasikowska, Johnny Depp, Anne Hathaway
plot_hint: Alice, now 19 years old, returns to the whimsical world she first entered as a child and embarks on a journey to discover her true destiny.
tagline_text: You're invited to a very important date.

title: Aliens
cast_hint: Sigourney Weaver, Carrie Henn, Michael Biehn
plot_hint: Ripley, the sole survivor of the Nostromo's deadly encounter with the monstrous Alien, returns to Earth after drifting through space in hypersleep for 57 years. Although her story is initially met with skepticism, she agrees to accompany a team of Colonial Marines back to LV-426.
tagline_text: This time it's war.

title: All That Jazz
cast_hint: Roy Scheider, Jessica Lange, Ann Reinking
plot_hint: Joe Gideon is at the top of the heap, one of the most successful directors and choreographers in musical theater. But he can feel his world slowly collapsing around him - his obsession with work has almost destroyed his personal life, and only his bottles of pills keep him going.
tagline_text: Prepare yourself for all that acclaim...

title: All the President's Men
cast_hint: Robert Redford, Dustin Hoffman, Jack Warden
plot_hint: During the 1972 elections, two reporters' investigation sheds light on the controversial Watergate scandal that compels President Nixon to resign from his post.
tagline_text: The most devastating detective story of this century.

title: Almost Famous
cast_hint: Billy Crudup, Frances McDormand, Kate Hudson
plot_hint: In 1973, 15-year-old William Miller's unabashed love of music and aspiration to become a rock journalist lands him an assignment from Rolling Stone magazine to interview and tour with the up-and-coming band, Stillwater.
tagline_text: Experience it. Enjoy it. Just don't fall for it.

title: Amadeus
cast_hint: F. Murray Abraham, Tom Hulce, Elizabeth Berridge
plot_hint: Disciplined Italian composer Antonio Salieri becomes consumed by jealousy and resentment towards the hedonistic and remarkably talented young Salzburger composer Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart.
tagline_text: The Man... The Music... The Madness... The Murder... The Motion Picture.

title: American Fiction
cast_hint: Jeffrey Wright, John Ortiz, Erika Alexander
plot_hint: A novelist fed up with the establishment profiting from "Black" entertainment uses a pen name to write a book that propels him into the heart of hypocrisy and the madness he claims to disdain.
tagline_text: Once you go full black, you ain't never going back!

title: American Graffiti
cast_hint: Richard Dreyfuss, Ron Howard, Paul Le Mat
plot_hint: A couple of high school graduates spend one final night cruising the strip with their buddies before they go off to college.
tagline_text: Where were you in '62?

title: American Hustle
cast_hint: Christian Bale, Bradley Cooper, Amy Adams
plot_hint: A conman and his seductive partner are forced to work for a wild FBI agent, who pushes them into a world of Jersey power-brokers and the Mafia.
tagline_text: Everyone hustles to survive.

title: American Pie
cast_hint: Jason Biggs, Chris Klein, Thomas Ian Nicholas
plot_hint: At a high-school party, four friends find that losing their collective virginity isn't as easy as they had thought. But they still believe that they need to do so before college. To motivate themselves, they enter a pact to all "score" by their senior prom.
tagline_text: There's nothing like your first piece.

title: American Sniper
cast_hint: Bradley Cooper, Sienna Miller, Kyle Gallner
plot_hint: U.S. Navy SEAL Chris Kyle takes his sole mission—protect his comrades—to heart and becomes one of the most lethal snipers in American history. His pinpoint accuracy not only saves countless lives but also makes him a prime target of insurgents. Despite grave danger and his struggle to be a good husband and father to his family back in the States, Kyle serves four tours of duty in Iraq. However, when he finally returns home, he finds that he cannot leave the war behind.
tagline_text: The most lethal sniper in U.S. history.

title: An Education
cast_hint: Carey Mulligan, Peter Sarsgaard, Dominic Cooper
plot_hint: Despite her sheltered upbringing, Jenny is a teen with a bright future; she's smart, pretty, and has aspirations of attending Oxford University. When David, a charming but much older suitor, motors into her life in a shiny automobile, Jenny gets a taste of adult life that she won't soon forget.
tagline_text: An education isn't always by the book.

title: An Officer and a Gentleman
cast_hint: Richard Gere, Debra Winger, Louis Gossett Jr.
plot_hint: Zack Mayo is an aloof, taciturn man who aspires to be a navy pilot. Once he arrives at training camp for his 13-week officer's course, Mayo runs afoul of abrasive, no-nonsense drill Sergeant Emil Foley. Mayo is an excellent cadet, but a little cold around the heart, so Foley rides him mercilessly, sensing that the young man would be prime officer material if he weren't so self-involved. Zack's affair with a working girl is likewise compromised by his unwillingness to give of himself.
tagline_text: Life gave him nothing, except the courage to win...and a woman to love.

title: An Unmarried Woman
cast_hint: Jill Clayburgh, Alan Bates, Michael Murphy
plot_hint: A wealthy woman from Manhattan's Upper East Side struggles to deal with her new identity and her sexuality after her husband of 16 years leaves her for a younger woman.
tagline_text: She laughs, she cries, she feels angry, she feels lonely, she feels guilty, she makes breakfast, she makes love, she makes do, she is strong, she is weak, she is brave, she is scared, she is… an unmarried woman.

title: Anatomy of a Fall
cast_hint: Sandra Hüller, Swann Arlaud, Milo Machado-Graner
plot_hint: A woman is suspected of her husband's murder, and their blind son faces a moral dilemma as the sole witness.
tagline_text: Did she do it?

title: Angels & Demons
cast_hint: Tom Hanks, Ewan McGregor, Ayelet Zurer
plot_hint: Harvard symbologist Robert Langdon is recruited by the Vatican to investigate the apparent return of the Illuminati – a secret, underground organization – after four cardinals are kidnapped on the night of the papal conclave.
tagline_text: The holiest event of our time. Perfect for their return.

title: Annie Hall
cast_hint: Woody Allen, Diane Keaton, Tony Roberts
plot_hint: New York comedian Alvy Singer falls in love with the ditsy Annie Hall.
tagline_text: A nervous romance.

title: Anora
cast_hint: Mikey Madison, Mark Eydelshteyn, Yura Borisov
plot_hint: A young sex worker from Brooklyn gets her chance at a Cinderella story when she meets and impulsively marries the son of an oligarch. Once the news reaches Russia, her fairytale is threatened as his parents set out to get the marriage annulled.
tagline_text: Love is a hustle.

title: Another Round
cast_hint: Mads Mikkelsen, Thomas Bo Larsen, Magnus Millang
plot_hint: Four stagnant high school teachers decide to test out a theory that maintaining a constant level of intoxication will improve their overall lives.
tagline_text: What is youth? A dream. What is love? The content of the dream.

title: Ant-Man and the Wasp: Quantumania
cast_hint: Paul Rudd, Evangeline Lilly, Michael Douglas
plot_hint: Super-Hero partners Scott Lang and Hope van Dyne, along with with Hope's parents Janet van Dyne and Hank Pym, and Scott's daughter Cassie Lang, find themselves exploring the Quantum Realm, interacting with strange new creatures and embarking on an adventure that will push them beyond the limits of what they thought possible.
tagline_text: Witness the beginning of a new dynasty.

title: Anyone But You
cast_hint: Sydney Sweeney, Glen Powell, Mia Artemis
plot_hint: After an amazing first date, Bea and Ben’s fiery attraction turns ice cold — until they find themselves unexpectedly reunited at a destination wedding in Australia. So they do what any two mature adults would do: pretend to be a couple.
tagline_text: They only look like the perfect couple.

title: Apocalypse Now
cast_hint: Martin Sheen, Marlon Brando, Frederic Forrest
plot_hint: At the height of the Vietnam war, Captain Benjamin Willard is sent on a dangerous mission that, officially, "does not exist, nor will it ever exist." His goal is to locate - and eliminate - a mysterious Green Beret Colonel named Walter Kurtz, who has been leading his personal army on illegal guerrilla missions into enemy territory.
tagline_text: This is the end...

title: Apollo 13
cast_hint: Tom Hanks, Bill Paxton, Kevin Bacon
plot_hint: The true story of technical troubles that scuttle the Apollo 13 lunar mission in 1970, risking the lives of astronaut Jim Lovell and his crew, with the failed journey turning into a thrilling saga of heroism. Drifting more than 200,000 miles from Earth, the astronauts work furiously with the ground crew to avert tragedy.
tagline_text: Houston, we have a problem.

title: Aquaman
cast_hint: Jason Momoa, Amber Heard, Willem Dafoe
plot_hint: Half-human, half-Atlantean Arthur Curry is taken on the journey of his lifetime to discover if he is worth of being a king.
tagline_text: Home is calling.

title: Aquaman and the Lost Kingdom
cast_hint: Jason Momoa, Patrick Wilson, Yahya Abdul-Mateen II
plot_hint: Black Manta seeks revenge on Aquaman for his father's death. Wielding the Black Trident's power, he becomes a formidable foe. To defend Atlantis, Arthur (Aquaman) forges an alliance with his imprisoned brother. They must protect the kingdom.
tagline_text: The tide is turning.

title: Argo
cast_hint: Ben Affleck, Bryan Cranston, Alan Arkin
plot_hint: As the Iranian revolution reaches a boiling point, a CIA 'exfiltration' specialist concocts a risky plan to free six Americans who have found shelter at the home of the Canadian ambassador.
tagline_text: The movie was fake. The mission was real.

title: Armageddon
cast_hint: Bruce Willis, Billy Bob Thornton, Ben Affleck
plot_hint: When an asteroid threatens to collide with Earth, NASA honcho Dan Truman determines the only way to stop it is to drill into its surface and detonate a nuclear bomb. This leads him to renowned driller Harry Stamper, who agrees to helm the dangerous space mission provided he can bring along his own hotshot crew. Among them is the cocksure A.J. who Harry thinks isn't good enough for his daughter, until the mission proves otherwise.
tagline_text: For love. For honor. For mankind.

title: Arrival
cast_hint: Amy Adams, Jeremy Renner, Forest Whitaker
plot_hint: Taking place after alien crafts land around the world, an expert linguist is recruited by the military to determine whether they come in peace or are a threat.
tagline_text: Why are they here?

title: As Good as It Gets
cast_hint: Jack Nicholson, Helen Hunt, Greg Kinnear
plot_hint: A misanthropic author, a single mother and waitress, and a gay artist form an unlikely friendship after the artist is assaulted in a robbery.
tagline_text: A comedy from the heart that goes for the throat.

title: Atlantic City
cast_hint: Burt Lancaster, Susan Sarandon, Kate Reid
plot_hint: In a corrupt city, a small-time gangster and the estranged wife of a pot dealer find themselves thrown together in an escapade of love, money, drugs and danger.
tagline_text: Where dreamers can be winners.

title: Atonement
cast_hint: James McAvoy, Keira Knightley, Saoirse Ronan
plot_hint: A young girl irrevocably changes the course of several lives when she accuses her older sister's lover of a crime he did not commit.
tagline_text: Torn apart by betrayal. Separated by war. Bound by love.

title: Austin Powers: The Spy Who Shagged Me
cast_hint: Mike Myers, Heather Graham, Verne Troyer
plot_hint: When diabolical genius Dr. Evil travels back in time to steal superspy Austin Powers's ‘mojo,’ Austin must return to the swingin' '60s himself - with the help of American agent, Felicity Shagwell - to stop the dastardly plan. Once there, Austin faces off against Dr. Evil's army of minions to try to save the world in his own unbelievably groovy way.
tagline_text: First he fought for the Crown. Now he's fighting for the Family Jewels.

title: Avatar: The Way of Water
cast_hint: Sam Worthington, Zoe Saldaña, Sigourney Weaver
plot_hint: Set more than a decade after the events of the first film, learn the story of the Sully family (Jake, Neytiri, and their kids), the trouble that follows them, the lengths they go to keep each other safe, the battles they fight to stay alive, and the tragedies they endure.
tagline_text: Return to Pandora.

title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
cast_hint: Robert Downey Jr., Chris Hemsworth, Mark Ruffalo
plot_hint: When Tony Stark tries to jumpstart a dormant peacekeeping program, things go awry and Earth’s Mightiest Heroes are put to the ultimate test as the fate of the planet hangs in the balance. As the villainous Ultron emerges, it is up to The Avengers to stop him from enacting his terrible plans, and soon uneasy alliances and unexpected action pave the way for an epic and unique global adventure.
tagline_text: A new age has come.

title: Avengers: Infinity War
cast_hint: Robert Downey Jr., Chris Evans, Chris Hemsworth
plot_hint: As the Avengers and their allies have continued to protect the world from threats too large for any one hero to handle, a new danger has emerged from the cosmic shadows: Thanos. A despot of intergalactic infamy, his goal is to collect all six Infinity Stones, artifacts of unimaginable power, and use them to inflict his twisted will on all of reality. Everything the Avengers have fought for has led up to this moment - the fate of Earth and existence itself has never been more uncertain.
tagline_text: Destiny arrives all the same.

title: Awakenings
cast_hint: Robert De Niro, Robin Williams, John Heard
plot_hint: Dr. Malcolm Sayer, a shy research physician, uses an experimental drug to "awaken" the catatonic victims of a rare disease. Leonard is the first patient to receive the controversial treatment. His awakening, filled with awe and enthusiasm, proves a rebirth for Sayer too, as the exuberant patient reveals life's simple but unutterably sweet pleasures to the introverted doctor.
tagline_text: There is no such thing as a simple miracle.

title: Babe
cast_hint: Christine Cavanaugh, Miriam Margolyes, Danny Mann
plot_hint: Babe is a little pig who doesn't quite know his place in the world. With a bunch of odd friends, like Ferdinand the duck who thinks he is a rooster and Fly the dog he calls mum, Babe realises that he has the makings to become the greatest sheep pig of all time, and Farmer Hoggett knows it. With the help of the sheep dogs, Babe learns that a pig can be anything that he wants to be.
tagline_text: A little pig goes a long way.

title: Babel
cast_hint: Brad Pitt, Rinko Kikuchi, Adriana Barraza
plot_hint: Tragedy strikes a married couple vacationing in the Moroccan desert, which jumpstarts an interlocking story involving four different families.
tagline_text: If you want to be understood... listen.

title: Bad Boys for Life
cast_hint: Will Smith, Martin Lawrence, Vanessa Hudgens
plot_hint: Marcus and Mike are forced to confront new threats, career changes, and midlife crises as they join the newly created elite team AMMO of the Miami police department to take down the ruthless Armando Armas, the vicious leader of a Miami drug cartel.
tagline_text: Ride together. Die together.

title: Bad Boys: Ride or Die
cast_hint: Will Smith, Martin Lawrence, Vanessa Hudgens
plot_hint: After their late former Captain is framed, Lowrey and Burnett try to clear his name, only to end up on the run themselves.
tagline_text: Miami's finest are now its most wanted.

title: Barbie
cast_hint: Margot Robbie, Ryan Gosling, America Ferrera
plot_hint: Barbie and Ken are having the time of their lives in the colorful and seemingly perfect world of Barbie Land. However, when they get a chance to go to the real world, they soon discover the joys and perils of living among humans.
tagline_text: She's everything. He's just Ken.

title: Basic Instinct
cast_hint: Michael Douglas, Sharon Stone, George Dzundza
plot_hint: Catherine, a novelist with an insatiable sexual appetite, becomes a prime suspect when her boyfriend is brutally murdered -- a crime she had described in her latest story.
tagline_text: A brutal murder. A brilliant killer. A cop who can't resist the danger.

title: Batman & Robin
cast_hint: George Clooney, Chris O'Donnell, Arnold Schwarzenegger
plot_hint: Batman and his sidekick Robin attempt to the foil the sinister schemes of a deranged set of new villains, most notably the melancholy Mr. Freeze, who wants to make Gotham City into an arctic region, and the sultry Poison Ivy, a botanical femme fatale. As the Dynamic Duo contend with these bad guys, a third hero, Batgirl, joins the ranks of the city's crime-fighters.
tagline_text: Strength now. Courage always. Family, above all. Batman and Robin!

title: Batman Forever
cast_hint: Val Kilmer, Tommy Lee Jones, Jim Carrey
plot_hint: Batman faces off against two foes: the schizophrenic, horribly scarred former District Attorney Harvey Dent, aka Two-Face, and the Riddler, a disgruntled ex-Wayne Enterprises inventor seeking revenge against his former employer by unleashing his brain-sucking weapon on Gotham City's residents. As the caped crusader also copes with tortured memories of his parents' murder, he has a new romance, with psychologist Chase Meridian.
tagline_text: Courage now, truth always, Batman forever!

title: Batman Returns
cast_hint: Michael Keaton, Danny DeVito, Michelle Pfeiffer
plot_hint: The monstrous Penguin, who dwells in the sewers beneath Gotham, joins up with corrupt mayoral candidate Max Shreck to topple the Batman once and for all. But when Shreck's timid assistant Selina Kyle finds out, and Shreck tries to kill her, she's transformed into the sexy Catwoman. She teams up with the Penguin and Shreck to destroy Batman, but sparks fly unexpectedly when she confronts the caped crusader.
tagline_text: The Bat. The Cat. The Penguin.

title: Beasts of the Southern Wild
cast_hint: Quvenzhané Wallis, Dwight Henry, Levy Easterly
plot_hint: Hushpuppy, an intrepid six-year-old girl, lives with her father, Wink, in 'the Bathtub', a southern Delta community at the edge of the world. Wink’s tough love prepares her for the unraveling of the universe—for a time when he’s no longer there to protect her. When Wink contracts a mysterious illness, nature flies out of whack—temperatures rise and the ice caps melt, unleashing an army of prehistoric creatures called aurochs. With the waters rising, the aurochs coming, and Wink’s health fading, Hushpuppy goes in search of her lost mother.
tagline_text: I gotta take care of mine.

title: Beauty and the Beast
cast_hint: Paige O'Hara, Robby Benson, Richard White
plot_hint: Follow the adventures of Belle, a bright young woman who finds herself in the castle of a prince who's been turned into a mysterious beast. With the help of the castle's enchanted staff, Belle soon learns the most important lesson of all -- that true beauty comes from within.
tagline_text: The most beautiful love story ever told.

title: Belfast
cast_hint: Jude Hill, Jamie Dornan, Caitríona Balfe
plot_hint: Buddy is a young boy on the cusp of adolescence, whose life is filled with familial love, childhood hijinks, and a blossoming romance. Yet, with his beloved hometown caught up in increasing turmoil, his family faces a momentous choice: hope the conflict will pass or leave everything they know behind for a new life.
tagline_text: No matter how far you go, you never forget where you came from.

title: Beverly Hills Cop
cast_hint: Eddie Murphy, Judge Reinhold, John Ashton
plot_hint: Fast-talking, quick-thinking Detroit street cop Axel Foley has bent more than a few rules and regs in his time, but when his best friend is murdered, he heads to sunny Beverly Hills to work the case like only he can.
tagline_text: He's been chased, thrown through a window and arrested. Eddie Murphy is a Detroit cop on vacation in Beverly Hills.

title: Beverly Hills Cop II
cast_hint: Eddie Murphy, Judge Reinhold, John Ashton
plot_hint: Axel Foley returns to the land of sunshine and palm trees to investigate the near-fatal shooting of police Captain Andrew Bogomil. With the help of Sgt. Taggart and Det. Rosewood, they soon uncover that the shooting is associated with a series of "alphabet" robberies masterminded by a heartless weapons kingpin—and the chase is on.
tagline_text: Axel Foley is back. Back where he doesn't belong.

title: Big
cast_hint: Tom Hanks, Elizabeth Perkins, Robert Loggia
plot_hint: When a young boy makes a wish at a carnival machine to be big—he wakes up the following morning to find that it has been granted and his body has grown older overnight. But he is still the same 13-year-old boy inside. Now he must learn how to cope with the unfamiliar world of grown-ups including getting a job and having his first romantic encounter with a woman.
tagline_text: Have you ever had a really big secret?

title: Big Hero 6
cast_hint: Scott Adsit, Ryan Potter, Daniel Henney
plot_hint: A special bond develops between plus-sized inflatable robot Baymax, and prodigy Hiro Hamada, who team up with a group of friends to form a band of high-tech heroes.
tagline_text: Drop everything. Save the world.

title: Birdman or (The Unexpected Virtue of Ignorance)
cast_hint: Michael Keaton, Emma Stone, Zach Galifianakis
plot_hint: A fading actor best known for his portrayal of a popular superhero attempts to mount a comeback by appearing in a Broadway play. As opening night approaches, his attempts to become more altruistic, rebuild his career, and reconnect with friends and family prove more difficult than expected.
tagline_text: How did we end up here?

title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
cast_hint: Letitia Wright, Tenoch Huerta Mejía, Lupita Nyong'o
plot_hint: Queen Ramonda, Shuri, M’Baku, Okoye and the Dora Milaje fight to protect their nation from intervening world powers in the wake of King T’Challa’s death.  As the Wakandans strive to embrace their next chapter, the heroes must band together with the help of War Dog Nakia and Everett Ross and forge a new path for the kingdom of Wakanda.
tagline_text: Forever.

title: Black Swan
cast_hint: Natalie Portman, Mila Kunis, Vincent Cassel
plot_hint: A committed dancer struggles to maintain her sanity after winning the lead role in a production of Tchaikovsky's "Swan Lake."
tagline_text: I just want to be perfect.

title: Black Widow
cast_hint: Scarlett Johansson, Florence Pugh, Rachel Weisz
plot_hint: Natasha Romanoff, also known as Black Widow, confronts the darker parts of her ledger when a dangerous conspiracy with ties to her past arises. Pursued by a force that will stop at nothing to bring her down, Natasha must deal with her history as a spy and the broken relationships left in her wake long before she became an Avenger.
tagline_text: Her world. Her secrets. Her legacy.

title: BlacKkKlansman
cast_hint: John David Washington, Adam Driver, Topher Grace
plot_hint: Colorado Springs, late 1970s. Ron Stallworth, an African American police officer, and Flip Zimmerman, his Jewish colleague, run an undercover operation to infiltrate the Ku Klux Klan.
tagline_text: Infiltrate hate.

title: Blazing Saddles
cast_hint: Cleavon Little, Gene Wilder, Slim Pickens
plot_hint: A town—where everyone seems to be named Johnson—stands in the way of the railroad. In order to grab their land, robber baron Hedley Lamarr sends his henchmen to make life in the town unbearable. After the sheriff is killed, the town demands a new sheriff from the Governor, so Hedley convinces him to send the town the first black sheriff in the west.
tagline_text: ...or never give a saga an even break!

title: Blue Beetle
cast_hint: Xolo Maridueña, Bruna Marquezine, Susan Sarandon
plot_hint: Recent college grad Jaime Reyes returns home full of aspirations for his future, only to find that home is not quite as he left it. As he searches to find his purpose in the world, fate intervenes when Jaime unexpectedly finds himself in possession of an ancient relic of alien biotechnology: the Scarab.
tagline_text: Jaime Reyes is a superhero whether he likes it or not.

title: Blue Velvet
cast_hint: Isabella Rossellini, Kyle MacLachlan, Dennis Hopper
plot_hint: The discovery of a severed human ear found in a field leads a young man on an investigation related to a beautiful, mysterious nightclub singer and a group of psychopathic criminals who have kidnapped her child.
tagline_text: It's a strange world, isn't it?

title: Bohemian Rhapsody
cast_hint: Rami Malek, Gwilym Lee, Ben Hardy
plot_hint: Singer Freddie Mercury, guitarist Brian May, drummer Roger Taylor and bass guitarist John Deacon take the music world by storm when they form the rock 'n' roll band Queen in 1970. Hit songs become instant classics. When Mercury's increasingly wild lifestyle starts to spiral out of control, Queen soon faces its greatest challenge yet – finding a way to keep the band together amid the success and excess.
tagline_text: Fearless lives forever.

title: Borat: Cultural Learnings of America for Make Benefit Glorious Nation of Kazakhstan
cast_hint: Sacha Baron Cohen, Ken Davitian, Luenell
plot_hint: Kazakh journalist Borat Sagdiyev travels to America to make a documentary. As he zigzags across the nation, Borat meets real people in real situations with hysterical consequences. His backwards behavior generates strong reactions around him exposing prejudices and hypocrisies in American culture.
tagline_text: Come to Kazakhstan, it's nice!

title: Born on the Fourth of July
cast_hint: Tom Cruise, Raymond J. Barry, Caroline Kava
plot_hint: Paralyzed in the Vietnam war, Ron Kovic becomes an anti-war and pro-human rights political activist after feeling betrayed by the country he fought for.
tagline_text: A true story of innocence lost and courage found.

title: Boyhood
cast_hint: Ellar Coltrane, Patricia Arquette, Ethan Hawke
plot_hint: The film tells a story of a divorced couple trying to raise their young son. The story follows the boy for twelve years, from first grade at age 6 through 12th grade at age 17-18, and examines his relationship with his parents as he grows.
tagline_text: 12 years in the making.

title: Bram Stoker's Dracula
cast_hint: Gary Oldman, Winona Ryder, Anthony Hopkins
plot_hint: Count Dracula, a 15th-century prince, is condemned to live off the blood of the living for eternity. Young lawyer Jonathan Harker is sent to Dracula's castle to finalise a land deal, but when the Count sees a photo of Harker's fiancée, Mina, the spitting image of his dead wife, he imprisons him and sets off for London to track her down.
tagline_text: Love never dies.

title: Brave
cast_hint: Kelly Macdonald, Emma Thompson, Billy Connolly
plot_hint: In the mystical Scottish Highlands, Merida is the princess of a kingdom ruled by King Fergus and Queen Elinor. An unruly daughter and an accomplished archer, Merida one day defies a sacred custom of the land and inadvertently brings turmoil to the kingdom. In an attempt to set things right, Merida seeks out an eccentric old Wise Woman and is granted an ill-fated wish. Also figuring into Merida's quest — and serving as comic relief — are the kingdom's three lords: the enormous Lord MacGuffin, the surly Lord Macintosh, and the disagreeable Lord Dingwall.
tagline_text: Change your fate.

title: Breaking Away
cast_hint: Dennis Christopher, Dennis Quaid, Daniel Stern
plot_hint: Dave, nineteen, has just graduated high school, with his three friends: the comical Cyril, the warm hearted but short-tempered Moocher, and the athletic, spiteful but good-hearted Mike. Now, Dave enjoys racing bikes and hopes to race the Italians one day, and even takes up the Italian culture, much to his friends' and parents' annoyance.
tagline_text: The movie that tells you exactly what you can do with your high school diploma!

title: Bridge of Spies
cast_hint: Tom Hanks, Mark Rylance, Amy Ryan
plot_hint: During the Cold War, the Soviet Union captures U.S. pilot Francis Gary Powers after shooting down his U-2 spy plane. Sentenced to 10 years in prison, Powers' only hope is New York lawyer James Donovan, recruited by a CIA operative to negotiate his release. Donovan boards a plane to Berlin, hoping to win the young man's freedom through a prisoner exchange. If all goes well, the Russians would get Rudolf Abel, the convicted spy who Donovan defended in court.
tagline_text: In the shadow of war, one man showed the world what we stood for.

title: Broadcast News
cast_hint: Holly Hunter, William Hurt, Albert Brooks
plot_hint: A high-strung news producer finds herself in a love triangle between a talented but self-doubting reporter and a charming news anchor who embodies the growing trivialization of news that she is determined to fight against.
tagline_text: It’s the story of their lives.

title: Brokeback Mountain
cast_hint: Heath Ledger, Jake Gyllenhaal, Michelle Williams
plot_hint: In 1960s Wyoming, two men develop a strong emotional and sexual relationship that endures as a lifelong connection complicating their lives as they get married and start families of their own.
tagline_text: Love is a force of nature.

title: Brooklyn
cast_hint: Saoirse Ronan, Domhnall Gleeson, Emory Cohen
plot_hint: In 1950s Ireland and New York, young Eilis Lacey has to choose between two men and two countries.
tagline_text: Two countries, two loves, one heart

title: Bruce Almighty
cast_hint: Jim Carrey, Morgan Freeman, Jennifer Aniston
plot_hint: Bruce Nolan toils as a "human interest" television reporter in Buffalo, NY, but despite his high ratings and the love of his beautiful girlfriend, Bruce remains unfulfilled. At the end of the worst day in his life, he angrily ridicules God — and the Almighty responds, endowing Bruce with all of His divine powers.
tagline_text: If you could be God for one week, what would you do?

title: Bugonia
cast_hint: Emma Stone, Jesse Plemons, Aidan Delbis
plot_hint: Two conspiracy obsessed young men kidnap the high-powered CEO of a major company, convinced that she is an alien intent on destroying planet Earth.
tagline_text: Of all the abductions, this one is different.

title: Bugsy
cast_hint: Warren Beatty, Annette Bening, Harvey Keitel
plot_hint: New York gangster Ben 'Bugsy' Siegel takes a brief business trip to Los Angeles. A sharp-dressing womanizer with a foul temper, Siegel doesn't hesitate to kill or maim anyone crossing him. In L.A. the life, the movies, and most of all strong-willed Virginia Hill detain him while his family wait back home. Then a trip to a run-down gambling joint at a spot in the desert known as Las Vegas gives him his big idea.
tagline_text: Glamour was the disguise.

title: Caddyshack
cast_hint: Chevy Chase, Rodney Dangerfield, Ted Knight
plot_hint: At an exclusive country club, an ambitious young caddy, Danny Noonan, eagerly pursues a caddy scholarship in hopes of attending college and, in turn, avoiding a job at the lumber yard. In order to succeed, he must first win the favour of the elitist Judge Smails, and then the caddy golf tournament which Smails sponsors.
tagline_text: Some people just don't belong.

title: Call Me by Your Name
cast_hint: Armie Hammer, Timothée Chalamet, Michael Stuhlbarg
plot_hint: In the summer of 1983, a 17-year-old Elio spends his days in his family's villa in Italy. One day Oliver, a graduate student, arrives to assist Elio's father, a professor of Greco-Roman culture. Soon, Elio and Oliver discover a summer that will alter their lives forever.
tagline_text: Is it better to speak or die?

title: Cape Fear
cast_hint: Gregory Peck, Robert Mitchum, Polly Bergen
plot_hint: Sam Bowden witnesses a rape committed by Max Cady and testifies against him. When released after 8 years in prison, Cady begins stalking Bowden and his family but is always clever enough not to violate the law.
tagline_text: Now he had only one weapon left—murder!

title: Capote
cast_hint: Philip Seymour Hoffman, Catherine Keener, Clifton Collins Jr.
plot_hint: A biopic of writer Truman Capote and his assignment for The New Yorker to write the non-fiction book "In Cold Blood".
tagline_text: In New York City, he was the ultimate insider. But out here, he was on the outside, looking in.

title: Captain America: Civil War
cast_hint: Chris Evans, Robert Downey Jr., Scarlett Johansson
plot_hint: Following the events of Age of Ultron, the collective governments of the world pass an act designed to regulate all superhuman activity. This polarizes opinion amongst the Avengers, causing two factions to side with Iron Man or Captain America, which causes an epic battle between former allies.
tagline_text: United we stand. Divided we fall.

title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
cast_hint: Chris Evans, Samuel L. Jackson, Scarlett Johansson
plot_hint: After the cataclysmic events in New York with The Avengers, Steve Rogers, aka Captain America is living quietly in Washington, D.C. and trying to adjust to the modern world. But when a S.H.I.E.L.D. colleague comes under attack, Steve becomes embroiled in a web of intrigue that threatens to put the world at risk. Joining forces with the Black Widow, Captain America struggles to expose the ever-widening conspiracy while fighting off professional assassins sent to silence him at every turn. When the full scope of the villainous plot is revealed, Captain America and the Black Widow enlist the help of a new ally, the Falcon. However, they soon find themselves up against an unexpected and formidable enemy—the Winter Soldier.
tagline_text: In heroes we trust.

title: Captain Marvel
cast_hint: Brie Larson, Samuel L. Jackson, Ben Mendelsohn
plot_hint: The story follows Carol Danvers as she becomes one of the universe’s most powerful heroes when Earth is caught in the middle of a galactic war between two alien races. Set in the 1990s, Captain Marvel is an all-new adventure from a previously unseen period in the history of the Marvel Cinematic Universe.
tagline_text: Higher. Further. Faster.

title: Captain Phillips
cast_hint: Tom Hanks, Barkhad Abdi, Barkhad Abdirahman
plot_hint: The true story of Captain Richard Phillips and the 2009 hijacking by Somali pirates of the US-flagged MV Maersk Alabama, the first American cargo ship to be hijacked in two hundred years.
tagline_text: Out here survival is everything.

title: Carnal Knowledge
cast_hint: Jack Nicholson, Candice Bergen, Art Garfunkel
plot_hint: Two lifelong friends navigate complex sexual encounters and emotional entanglements, wrestling with societal norms and personal desires.
tagline_text: Its time has come.

title: Carrie
cast_hint: Sissy Spacek, Piper Laurie, Amy Irving
plot_hint: Withdrawn and sensitive teenager Carrie White faces bullying from her classmates and abuse from her fanatically pious mother. When she begins to suspect that she has supernatural powers, things take a dark and violent turn.
tagline_text: If you've got a taste for terror…Take Carrie to the prom.

title: Cars
cast_hint: Owen Wilson, Paul Newman, Bonnie Hunt
plot_hint: Lightning McQueen, a hotshot rookie race car driven to succeed, discovers that life is about the journey, not the finish line, when he finds himself unexpectedly detoured in the sleepy Route 66 town of Radiator Springs. On route across the country to the big Piston Cup Championship in California to compete against two seasoned pros, McQueen gets to know the town's offbeat characters.
tagline_text: Ahhh... it's got that new movie smell.

title: Cars 2
cast_hint: Larry the Cable Guy, Owen Wilson, Michael Caine
plot_hint: Star race car Lightning McQueen and his pal Mater head overseas to compete in the World Grand Prix race. But the road to the championship becomes rocky as Mater gets caught up in an intriguing adventure of his own: international espionage.
tagline_text: The Mission Begins.

title: Cars 3
cast_hint: Owen Wilson, Cristela Alonzo, Chris Cooper
plot_hint: Blindsided by a new generation of blazing-fast racers, the legendary Lightning McQueen is suddenly pushed out of the sport he loves. To get back in the game, he will need the help of an eager young race technician with her own plan to win, inspiration from the late Fabulous Hudson Hornet, and a few unexpected turns.
tagline_text: From this moment, everything will change.

title: Casino Royale
cast_hint: Daniel Craig, Eva Green, Mads Mikkelsen
plot_hint: Le Chiffre, a banker to the world's terrorists, is scheduled to participate in a high-stakes poker game in Montenegro, where he intends to use his winnings to establish his financial grip on the terrorist market. M sends Bond—on his maiden mission as a 00 Agent—to attend this game and prevent Le Chiffre from winning. With the help of Vesper Lynd and Felix Leiter, Bond enters the most important poker game in his already dangerous career.
tagline_text: Everyone has a past. Every legend has a beginning.

title: Casper
cast_hint: Christina Ricci, Bill Pullman, Cathy Moriarty
plot_hint: Casper is a kind young ghost who peacefully haunts a mansion in Maine. When specialist James Harvey arrives to communicate with Casper and his fellow spirits, he brings along his teenage daughter, Kat. Casper quickly falls in love with Kat, but their budding relationship is complicated not only by his transparent state, but also by his troublemaking apparition uncles and their mischievous antics.
tagline_text: Seeing is believing.

title: Cast Away
cast_hint: Tom Hanks, Helen Hunt, Chris Noth
plot_hint: Chuck Noland, a top international manager for FedEx, and Kelly, a Ph.D. student, are in love and heading towards marriage. Then Chuck's plane to Malaysia crashes at sea during a terrible storm. He's the only survivor, and finds himself marooned on a desolate island. With no way to escape, Chuck must find ways to survive in his new home.
tagline_text: At the edge of the world, his journey begins.

title: Catch Me If You Can
cast_hint: Leonardo DiCaprio, Tom Hanks, Christopher Walken
plot_hint: A true story about Frank Abagnale Jr. who, before his 19th birthday, successfully conned millions of dollars worth of checks as a Pan Am pilot, doctor, and legal prosecutor. An FBI agent makes it his mission to put him behind bars. But Frank not only eludes capture, he revels in the pursuit.
tagline_text: The true story of a real fake.

title: Chariots of Fire
cast_hint: Ben Cross, Ian Charleson, Cheryl Campbell
plot_hint: In the class-obsessed and religiously divided UK of the early 1920s, two determined young runners train for the 1924 Paris Olympics. Eric Liddell, a devout Christian born to Scottish missionaries in China, sees running as part of his worship of God's glory and refuses to train or compete on the Sabbath. Harold Abrahams overcomes anti-Semitism and class bias, but neglects his beloved sweetheart in his single-minded quest.
tagline_text: This is the story of two men who run, not to run, but to prove something to the world. They will sacrifice anything to achieve their goals... except their honor.

title: Chicago
cast_hint: Renée Zellweger, Catherine Zeta-Jones, Richard Gere
plot_hint: Murderesses Velma Kelly and Roxie Hart find themselves on death row together and fight for the fame that will keep them from the gallows in 1920s Chicago.
tagline_text: If you can't be famous, be infamous.

title: Child's Play
cast_hint: Catherine Hicks, Chris Sarandon, Alex Vincent
plot_hint: After being shot in a toy store, a serial killer transfers his soul into a Good Guy doll. A mother then gifts it to her 6-year old son Andy, which unleashes terror upon the city.
tagline_text: You'll wish it was only make-believe.

title: Children of a Lesser God
cast_hint: William Hurt, Marlee Matlin, Piper Laurie
plot_hint: Starting his new job as an instructor at a New England school for the deaf, James Leeds meets Sarah Norman, a young deaf woman who works at the school as a member of the custodial staff. In spite of Sarah's withdrawn emotional state, a romance slowly develops between the pair.
tagline_text: She is the most mysterious, independent, beautiful, angry person he has ever met. He is the first man who has ever gotten close enough to love her.

title: Chinatown
cast_hint: Jack Nicholson, Faye Dunaway, John Huston
plot_hint: Private eye Jake Gittes lives off of the murky moral climate of sunbaked, pre-World War II Southern California. Hired by a beautiful socialite to investigate her husband's extra-marital affair, Gittes is swept into a maelstrom of double dealings and deadly deceits, uncovering a web of personal and political scandals that come crashing together.
tagline_text: You get tough. You get tender. You get close to each other. Maybe you even get close to the truth.

title: Chocolat
cast_hint: Juliette Binoche, Judi Dench, Alfred Molina
plot_hint: In the winter of 1959, a single mother and her young daughter arrive in a rural French town, where they open an unusual chocolate shop that disrupts the moral fiber of the strictly Catholic townsfolk and mayor.
tagline_text: One taste is all it takes.

title: Close Encounters of the Third Kind
cast_hint: Richard Dreyfuss, François Truffaut, Teri Garr
plot_hint: After an encounter with UFOs, an electricity linesman feels undeniably drawn to an isolated area in the wilderness where something spectacular is about to happen.
tagline_text: We are not alone.

title: Coal Miner's Daughter
cast_hint: Sissy Spacek, Tommy Lee Jones, Levon Helm
plot_hint: Biography of Loretta Lynn, a country and western singer that came from poverty to fame.
tagline_text: She became a singer because it was the only thing she could do. She became a star because it was the only way she could do it.

title: Coco
cast_hint: Anthony Gonzalez, Gael García Bernal, Benjamin Bratt
plot_hint: Despite his family’s baffling generations-old ban on music, Miguel dreams of becoming an accomplished musician like his idol, Ernesto de la Cruz. Desperate to prove his talent, Miguel finds himself in the stunning and colorful Land of the Dead following a mysterious chain of events. Along the way, he meets charming trickster Hector, and together, they set off on an extraordinary journey to unlock the real story behind Miguel's family history.
tagline_text: The celebration of a lifetime.

title: Cocoon
cast_hint: Steve Guttenberg, Tahnee Welch, Brian Dennehy
plot_hint: When a group of trespassing seniors swim in a pool containing alien cocoons, they find themselves energized with youthful vigor.
tagline_text: It is everything you've dreamed of. It is nothing you expect.

title: CODA
cast_hint: Emilia Jones, Marlee Matlin, Troy Kotsur
plot_hint: As a CODA (Child of Deaf Adults), Ruby is the only hearing person in her deaf family. When the family's fishing business is threatened, Ruby finds herself torn between pursuing her love of music and her fear of abandoning her parents.
tagline_text: Every family has its own language.

title: Coming to America
cast_hint: Eddie Murphy, Arsenio Hall, Shari Headley
plot_hint: An African prince decides it’s time for him to find a princess... and his mission leads him and his most loyal friend to Queens, New York. In disguise as an impoverished immigrant, the pampered prince quickly finds himself a new job, new friends, new digs, new enemies and lots of trouble.
tagline_text: This summer, Prince Akeem discovers America.

title: Conan the Barbarian
cast_hint: Arnold Schwarzenegger, James Earl Jones, Max von Sydow
plot_hint: A horde of rampaging warriors massacre the parents of young Conan and enslave the young child for years on The Wheel of Pain. As the sole survivor of the childhood massacre, Conan is released from slavery and taught the ancient arts of fighting. Transforming himself into a killing machine, Conan travels into the wilderness to seek vengeance on Thulsa Doom, the man responsible for killing his family. In the wilderness, Conan takes up with the thieves Valeria and Subotai. The group comes upon King Osric, who wants the trio of warriors to help rescue his daughter who has joined Doom in the hills.
tagline_text: Thief. Warrior. Gladiator. King.

title: Conclave
cast_hint: Ralph Fiennes, Stanley Tucci, John Lithgow
plot_hint: After the unexpected death of the Pope, Cardinal Lawrence is tasked with managing the covert and ancient ritual of electing a new one. Sequestered in the Vatican with the Catholic Church’s most powerful leaders until the process is complete, Lawrence finds himself at the center of a conspiracy that could lead to its downfall.
tagline_text: What happens behind these walls will change everything.

title: Crocodile Dundee
cast_hint: Paul Hogan, Linda Kozlowski, Mark Blum
plot_hint: When a New York reporter plucks crocodile hunter Mick Dundee from the Australian Outback for a visit to the Big Apple, it's a clash of cultures and a recipe for good-natured comedy as naïve Dundee negotiates the concrete jungle. He proves that his instincts are quite useful in the city and adeptly handles everything from wily muggers to high-society snoots without breaking a sweat.
tagline_text: There's a little of him in all of us.

title: Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon
cast_hint: Chow Yun-Fat, Michelle Yeoh, Zhang Ziyi
plot_hint: Two warriors in pursuit of a stolen sword and a notorious fugitive are led to an impetuous, physically-skilled, teenage nobleman's daughter, who is at a crossroads in her life.
tagline_text: A timeless story of strength, secrets and two warriors who would never surrender.

title: Cruel Jaws
cast_hint: David Luther, George Barnes Jr., Scott Silveria
plot_hint: A tiger shark bred by the Navy as a killing machine is wreaking havoc in the sleepy tourist town of Hampton Bay.
tagline_text: This time it's even more personal than the last time.

title: Dallas Buyers Club
cast_hint: Matthew McConaughey, Jennifer Garner, Jared Leto
plot_hint: Loosely based on the true-life tale of Ron Woodroof, a drug-taking, women-loving, homophobic man who in 1986 was diagnosed with HIV/AIDS and given thirty days to live.
tagline_text: Dare to live.

title: Dances with Wolves
cast_hint: Kevin Costner, Mary McDonnell, Graham Greene
plot_hint: Wounded Civil War soldier John Dunbar tries to commit suicide—and becomes a hero instead. As a reward, he's assigned to his dream post, a remote junction on the Western frontier, and soon makes unlikely friends with the local Sioux tribe.
tagline_text: Inside everyone is a frontier waiting to be discovered.

title: Dangerous Liaisons
cast_hint: Glenn Close, John Malkovich, Michelle Pfeiffer
plot_hint: In 18th century France, Marquise de Merteuil asks her ex-lover Vicomte de Valmont to seduce the future wife of another ex-lover of hers in return for one last night with her. Yet things don’t go as planned.
tagline_text: Lust. Seduction. Revenge. The game as you've never seen it played before.

title: Darkest Hour
cast_hint: Gary Oldman, Stephen Dillane, Lily James
plot_hint: In May 1940, the fate of World War II hangs on Winston Churchill, who must decide whether to negotiate with Adolf Hitler or fight on knowing that it could mean the end of the British Empire.
tagline_text: Never give up. Never give in.

title: Dawn of the Planet of the Apes
cast_hint: Andy Serkis, Jason Clarke, Toby Kebbell
plot_hint: A group of scientists in San Francisco struggle to stay alive in the aftermath of a plague that is wiping out humanity, while Caesar tries to maintain dominance over his community of intelligent apes.
tagline_text: The future is worth fighting for.

title: Dead Poets Society
cast_hint: Robin Williams, Robert Sean Leonard, Ethan Hawke
plot_hint: At an elite, old-fashioned boarding school in New England, a passionate English teacher inspires his students to rebel against convention and seize the potential of every day, courting the disdain of the stern headmaster.
tagline_text: He was their inspiration. He made their lives extraordinary.

title: Deadpool & Wolverine
cast_hint: Ryan Reynolds, Hugh Jackman, Emma Corrin
plot_hint: A listless Wade Wilson toils away in civilian life with his days as the morally flexible mercenary, Deadpool, behind him. But when his homeworld faces an existential threat, Wade must reluctantly suit-up again with an even more reluctant Wolverine.
tagline_text: Come together.

title: Deadpool 2
cast_hint: Ryan Reynolds, Josh Brolin, Morena Baccarin
plot_hint: Wisecracking mercenary Deadpool battles the evil and powerful Cable and other bad guys to save a boy's life.
tagline_text: Prepare for the Second Coming.

title: Deliverance
cast_hint: Jon Voight, Burt Reynolds, Ned Beatty
plot_hint: Intent on seeing the Cahulawassee River before it's turned into one huge lake, outdoor fanatic Lewis Medlock takes his friends on a river-rafting trip they'll never forget into the dangerous American back-country.
tagline_text: What did happen on the Cahulawassee River?

title: Demon Slayer -Kimetsu no Yaiba- The Movie: Mugen Train
cast_hint: Natsuki Hanae, Akari Kito, Hiro Shimono
plot_hint: Tanjiro Kamado, joined with Inosuke Hashibira, a boy raised by boars who wears a boar's head, and Zenitsu Agatsuma, a scared boy who reveals his true power when he sleeps, boards the Infinity Train on a new mission with the Fire Hashira, Kyojuro Rengoku, to defeat a demon who has been tormenting the people and killing the demon slayers who oppose it!
tagline_text: With your blade, bring an end to the nightmare.

title: Despicable Me 2
cast_hint: Steve Carell, Kristen Wiig, Benjamin Bratt

tagline_text: More minions. More despicable.

tagline_text: Oh brother.

tagline_text: Things just got a little more despicable.

tagline_text: The man who made 007 a household number.

title: Die Hard: With a Vengeance

tagline_text: Think fast. Look alive. Die hard.

title: Dirty Dancing

plot_hint: Expecting the usual tedium that accompanies a summer in the Catskills with her family, 17-year-old Frances 'Baby' Houseman is surprised to find herself stepping into the shoes of a professional hoofer—and unexpectedly falling in love.
tagline_text: First dance. First love. The time of your life.

tagline_text: Detective Harry Callahan. He doesn't break murder cases. He smashes them.

When a company field agent contracts a mysterious virus that begins to alter his DNA, there is only one place he can hide: District 9.
tagline_text: You are not welcome here.

title: Django Unchained
cast_hint: Jamie Foxx, Christoph Waltz, Leonardo DiCaprio

tagline_text: Life, liberty, and the pursuit of vengeance.

The wall becomes a symbol of racism and hate to Buggin' Out and to other people in the neighborhood, and tensions rise.
tagline_text: It's the hottest day of the summer. You can do nothing, you can do something, or you can...

title: Doctor Strange
cast_hint: Benedict Cumberbatch, Chiwetel Ejiofor, Rachel McAdams
plot_hint: After his career is destroyed, a brilliant but arrogant surgeon gets a new lease on life when a sorcerer takes him under her wing and trains him to defend the world against evil.
tagline_text: The impossibilities are endless.

cast_hint: Benedict Cumberbatch, Xochitl Gomez, Elizabeth Olsen
plot_hint: Doctor Strange, with the help of mystical allies both old and new, traverses the mind-bending and dangerous alternate realities of the Multiverse to confront a mysterious new adversary.
tagline_text: Enter a new dimension of Strange.

title: Dog Day Afternoon

Sonny and Sal attempt a bank heist which quickly turns sour and escalates into a hostage situation and stand-off with the police. As Sonny's motives for the robbery are slowly revealed and things become more complicated, the heist turns into a media circus.
tagline_text: Anything can happen during the dog days of summer. On August 22nd, 1972, everything did.

title: Don't Look Up

tagline_text: Based on truly possible events.

title: Drive My Car

There he meets Misaki, an introverted young woman, appointed to drive his car. In between rides, secrets from the past and heartfelt confessions will be unveiled.
tagline_text: Go on living.

title: Driving Miss Daisy
cast_hint: Morgan Freeman, Jessica Tandy, Dan Aykroyd

tagline_text: The funny, touching and totally irresistible story of a working relationship that became a 25-year friendship.

title: Dumb and Dumber
cast_hint: Jim Carrey, Jeff Daniels, Lauren Holly
plot_hint: Lloyd and Harry are two men whose stupidity is really indescribable. After some "adventures" they finally get to Aspen where, using the lost money they live it up and fight for Mary's heart.
tagline_text: For Harry and Lloyd, every day is a no-brainer.

tagline_text: It begins.

title: Dune: Part Two
cast_hint: Timothée Chalamet, Zendaya, Rebecca Ferguson
plot_hint: Follow the mythic journey of Paul Atreides as he unites with Chani and the Fremen while on a path of revenge against the conspirators who destroyed his family. Facing a choice between the love of his life and the fate of the known universe, Paul endeavors to prevent a terrible future only he can foresee.
tagline_text: Long live the fighters.

title: Earthquake

tagline_text: When the big one finally hits L.A.

tagline_text: Declared illegitimate aged 3. Tried for treason aged 21. Crowned Queen aged 25.

title: Elvis

plot_hint: The life story of Elvis Presley as seen through the complicated relationship with his enigmatic manager, Colonel Tom Parker.
tagline_text: The Man. The Legend. The King of Rock & Roll.

plot_hint: Rita, an underrated lawyer working for a large law firm more interested in getting criminals out of jail than bringing them to justice, is hired by the leader of a criminal organization.
tagline_text: Passion has a new name.

But when she discovers that the magic surrounding the Encanto is in danger, Mirabel decides that she, the only ordinary Madrigal, might just be her exceptional family's last hope.
tagline_text: There's a little magic in all of us...almost all of us.

title: Enter the Dragon

tagline_text: She brought a small town to its feet and a huge company to its knees.

title: Escape from Alcatraz

title: Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind

tagline_text: Not all blood is family.

tagline_text: From J.K. Rowling's wizarding world.

Enter Police Chief Marge, a coffee-drinking, parka-wearing - and extremely pregnant - investigator who'll stop at nothing to get her man. And if you think her small-time investigative skills will give the crooks a run for their ransom... you betcha!

tagline_text: Get the fifth gear.

tagline_text: The end of the road begins.

title: Fatal Attraction

tagline_text: A look that led to an evening. A mistake he'll regret... FOR THE REST OF HIS LIFE.

title: Fiddler on the Roof

plot_hint: Dory is reunited with her friends Nemo and Marlin in the search for answers about her past. What can she remember? Who are her parents? And where did she learn to speak Whale?
tagline_text: An unforgettable journey she probably won't remember.

plot_hint: During a writing slump, playwright J.M. Barrie meets a widow and her four children, all young boys—who soon become an important part of Barrie’s life and the inspiration that lead him to create his masterpiece. Peter Pan.
tagline_text: Where will your imagination take you?

title: Five Nights at Freddy's

plot_hint: Recently fired and desperate for work, a troubled young man named Mike agrees to take a position as a night security guard at an abandoned theme restaurant: Freddy Fazbear's Pizzeria. But he soon discovers that nothing at Freddy's is what it seems.
tagline_text: Can you survive five nights?

title: Flashdance

tagline_text: There comes a time to cut loose

title: Ford v Ferrari

tagline_text: They took the American dream for a ride.

title: Four Weddings and a Funeral

tagline_text: Only monsters play God.

Nixon surprised everyone in selecting Frost as his televised confessor, intending to easily outfox the breezy British showman and secure a place in the hearts and minds of Americans. Likewise, Frost's team harboured doubts about their boss's ability to hold his own. But as the cameras rolled, a charged battle of wits resulted.
tagline_text: 400 million people were waiting for the truth.

title: Frozen II
cast_hint: Idina Menzel, Kristen Bell, Josh Gad
plot_hint: Elsa, Anna, Kristoff and Olaf head far into the forest to learn the truth about an ancient mystery of their kingdom.
tagline_text: The past is not what it seems.

When the couple hears that Globodyne boss Jack McCallister actually swindled the company, they plot revenge.
tagline_text: Giving big businesses a run for their money!

title: Funny Lady

tagline_text: His triumph changed the world forever.

title: Gangs of New York

title: Godzilla x Kong: The New Empire

tagline_text: Rise together or fall alone.

tagline_text: No limits. No fears. No substitutes.

title: Good Night, and Good Luck.

plot_hint: The story of journalist Edward R. Murrow's stand against Senator Joseph McCarthy's anti-communist witch-hunts in the early 1950s.
tagline_text: We will not walk in fear of one another.

plot_hint: Will Hunting is a headstrong, working-class genius who is failing the lessons of life. After one too many run-ins with the law, Will's last chance is a psychology professor, who might be the only man who can reach him.
tagline_text: Some people can never believe in themselves, until someone believes in them.

title: Gosford Park

title: Gravity

plot_hint: Dr Ryan Stone, an engineer on her first space mission, and Matt Kowalski, an astronaut on his final expedition, have to survive in space after they are hit by debris while spacewalking.
tagline_text: Don't let go.

tagline_text: Only one of them will survive.

title: Halloween II
cast_hint: Jamie Lee Curtis, Donald Pleasence, Charles Cyphers
plot_hint: After failing to kill stubborn survivor Laurie and taking a bullet or six from former psychiatrist Dr. Sam Loomis, Michael Myers has followed Laurie to the Haddonfield Memorial Hospital, where she's been admitted for Myers' attempt on her life. The institution proves to be particularly suited to serial killers, however, as Myers cuts, stabs and slashes his way through hospital staff to reach his favorite victim.
tagline_text: More of the night he came home.

title: Halloween Kills
cast_hint: Jamie Lee Curtis, Judy Greer, Andi Matichak
plot_hint: Michael manages to free himself from Laurie Strode's trap to resume his ritual bloodbath. As she fights for her life from injuries from their last encounter, she inspires her daughter Karen, her granddaughter Allyson, and all of Haddonfield to rise up against the unstoppable monster.
tagline_text: Evil dies tonight.

title: Hamnet
cast_hint: Jessie Buckley, Paul Mescal, Emily Watson
plot_hint: The powerful story of love and loss that inspired the creation of Shakespeare's timeless masterpiece, Hamlet.
tagline_text: Keep your heart open.

title: Hancock
cast_hint: Will Smith, Charlize Theron, Jason Bateman
plot_hint: Hancock is a down-and-out superhero who's forced to employ a PR expert to help repair his image when the public grows weary of all the damage he's inflicted during his lifesaving heroics. The agent's idea of imprisoning the antihero to make the world miss him proves successful, but will Hancock stick to his new sense of purpose or slip back into old habits?
tagline_text: There are heroes. There are superheroes. And then there's Hancock.

title: Hannah and Her Sisters
cast_hint: Mia Farrow, Barbara Hershey, Dianne Wiest
plot_hint: Between two Thanksgivings, Hannah's husband falls in love with her sister Lee, while her hypochondriac ex-husband rekindles his relationship with her sister Holly.
tagline_text: A story between two Thanksgivings.

title: Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets
cast_hint: Daniel Radcliffe, Rupert Grint, Emma Watson
plot_hint: Cars fly, trees fight back, and a mysterious house-elf comes to warn Harry Potter at the start of his second year at Hogwarts. Adventure and danger await when bloody writing on a wall announces: The Chamber Of Secrets Has Been Opened. To save Hogwarts will require all of Harry, Ron and Hermione's magical abilities and courage.
tagline_text: Something evil has returned to Hogwarts!

title: Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire
cast_hint: Daniel Radcliffe, Rupert Grint, Emma Watson
plot_hint: When his name emerges from the Goblet of Fire, Harry Potter becomes a competitor in a grueling battle for glory among three wizarding schools. Signs of Voldemort's return emerge as Harry's friends help him prepare for the Triwizard Tournament.
tagline_text: Dark and difficult times lie ahead.

title: Harry Potter and the Half-Blood Prince
cast_hint: Daniel Radcliffe, Rupert Grint, Emma Watson
plot_hint: Dumbledore tries to prepare Harry for the final battle with Voldemort while Death Eaters wreak havoc in both Muggle and Wizard worlds.
tagline_text: Dark secrets revealed.

title: Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix
cast_hint: Daniel Radcliffe, Rupert Grint, Emma Watson
plot_hint: When a new professor's methods leave Hogwarts unprepared to fight the rising tide of evil, Harry teaches students how to defend against the dark arts.
tagline_text: The rebellion begins.

title: Heaven Can Wait
cast_hint: Warren Beatty, Julie Christie, James Mason
plot_hint: Joe Pendleton is a quarterback preparing to lead his team to the superbowl when he is almost killed in an accident. An overanxious angel plucks him to heaven only to discover that he wasn't ready to die, and that his body has been cremated. A new body must be found, and that of a recently-murdered millionaire is chosen. His wife and accountant—the murderers—are confused by this development, as he buys the L.A. Rams in order to once again quarterback them into the Superbowl.
tagline_text: Joe Pendleton... the only guy who ever raised Hell about going to Heaven.

title: Hell or High Water
cast_hint: Jeff Bridges, Chris Pine, Ben Foster
plot_hint: A divorced dad and his ex-con brother resort to a desperate scheme in order to save their family's farm in West Texas.
tagline_text: Blood always follows money.

title: Her
cast_hint: Joaquin Phoenix, Scarlett Johansson, Lynn Adrianna
plot_hint: In the not so distant future, Theodore, a lonely writer, purchases a newly developed operating system designed to meet the user's every need. To Theodore's surprise, a romantic relationship develops between him and his operating system. This unconventional love story blends science fiction and romance in a sweet tale that explores the nature of love and the ways that technology isolates and connects us all.
tagline_text: A Spike Jonze love story.

title: Herbie Goes to Monte Carlo
cast_hint: Dean Jones, Don Knotts, Julie Sommars
plot_hint: Herbie, the Volkswagen Beetle with a mind of its own, is racing in the Monte Carlo Rally. But thieves have hidden a cache of stolen diamonds in Herbie's gas tank, and are now trying to get them back.
tagline_text: The Love Bug falls 'hood-over-wheels' for a classy chassis!

title: Hi, Mom!
cast_hint: Robert De Niro, Jennifer Salt, Allen Garfield
plot_hint: Vietnam vet Jon Rubin returns to New York and rents a rundown flat in Greenwich Village. It is in this flat that he begins to film, 'Peeping Tom' style, the people in the apartment across the street. His obsession with making films leads him to fall in with a radical 'Black Power' group, which in turn leads him to carry out a bizarre act of urban terrorism.
tagline_text: God bless our humble upper-middle-class high-rise co-op and keep it free from smut peddlers, militants, urban guerrillas and Greenwich Village liberals.

title: Hidden Figures
cast_hint: Taraji P. Henson, Octavia Spencer, Janelle Monáe
plot_hint: The untold story of Katherine G. Johnson, Dorothy Vaughan and Mary Jackson – brilliant African-American women working at NASA and serving as the brains behind one of the greatest operations in history – the launch of astronaut John Glenn into orbit. The visionary trio crossed all gender and race lines to inspire generations to dream big.
tagline_text: Meet the women you don't know, behind the mission you do.

title: Highlander
cast_hint: Christopher Lambert, Roxanne Hart, Clancy Brown
plot_hint: He fought his first battle on the Scottish Highlands in 1536. He will fight his greatest battle on the streets of New York City in 1986. His name is Connor MacLeod. He is immortal.
tagline_text: There can be only one.

title: Hocus Pocus
cast_hint: Bette Midler, Sarah Jessica Parker, Kathy Najimy
plot_hint: After 300 years of slumber, three sister witches are accidentally resurrected in Salem on Halloween night, and it is up to three kids and their newfound feline friend to put an end to the witches' reign of terror once and for all.
tagline_text: It's just a bunch of Hocus Pocus.

title: Home Alone 3
cast_hint: Alex D. Linz, Olek Krupa, Rya Kihlstedt
plot_hint: 9-year-old Alex Pruitt is home alone with the chicken pox. Turns out, due to a mix-up among nefarious spies, Alex was given a toy car concealing a top-secret microchip. Now Alex must fend off the spies as they try to break into his house to get it back.
tagline_text: There's a new kid on the block.

title: Hook
cast_hint: Dustin Hoffman, Robin Williams, Julia Roberts
plot_hint: The boy who wasn't supposed to grow up—Peter Pan—does just that, becoming a soulless corporate lawyer whose workaholism could cost him his wife and kids. During his trip to see Granny Wendy in London, the vengeful Capt. Hook kidnaps Peter's kids and forces Peter to return to Neverland.
tagline_text: To live would be an awfully big adventure.

title: Hooper
cast_hint: Burt Reynolds, Jan-Michael Vincent, Sally Field
plot_hint: Legendary stunt man Sonny Hooper remains one of the top men in his field, but due to too many stressful impacts to the spine and the need to pop painkillers several times a day, he knows he should get out of the industry before he ends up permanently disabled.
tagline_text: Ain't nobody can fly a car like Hooper!

title: Hope and Glory
cast_hint: Sebastian Rice-Edwards, Geraldine Muir, Sarah Miles
plot_hint: A middle-aged man recalls his childhood growing up in and around London during World War II.
tagline_text: The epic story of a world at war. And a boy at play.

title: Hotel Transylvania
cast_hint: Adam Sandler, Andy Samberg, Selena Gomez
plot_hint: Welcome to Hotel Transylvania, Dracula's lavish five-stake resort, where monsters and their families can live it up and no humans are allowed. One special weekend, Dracula has invited all his best friends to celebrate his beloved daughter Mavis's 118th birthday. For Dracula catering to all of these legendary monsters is no problem but the party really starts when one ordinary guy stumbles into the hotel and changes everything!
tagline_text: Where monsters go to get away from it all.

title: Hotel Transylvania 2
cast_hint: Adam Sandler, Andy Samberg, Selena Gomez
plot_hint: When the old-old-old-fashioned vampire Vlad arrives at the hotel for an impromptu family get-together, Hotel Transylvania is in for a collision of supernatural old-school and modern day cool.
tagline_text: They're back to raise a little terror.

title: Hotel Transylvania 3: Summer Vacation
cast_hint: Adam Sandler, Andy Samberg, Selena Gomez
plot_hint: Dracula, Mavis, Johnny and the rest of the Drac Pack take a vacation on a luxury Monster Cruise Ship, where Dracula falls in love with the ship’s captain, Ericka, who’s secretly a descendant of Abraham Van Helsing, the notorious monster slayer.
tagline_text: He's going to need a vacation after this vacation.
